basic_info.description: Step into this Parkside ocean-view beauty, offering 4 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, and 1,600 sqft of comfortable living space. Recently refreshed with new exterior paint, this home captures stunning ocean views from the rear bedrooms, bringing natural beauty indoors. The upper level welcomes you through a classic tunnel entrance, leading to a bright living room with a cozy fireplace, an elegant dining room, a remodeled kitchen, and two spacious bedrooms. The lower level adds versatility with two bonus bedrooms, a wet bar, a full bathroom, and direct access to the one-car garage. The property also features a large backyard, a pass-through closet to the primary bedroom, and a full basement for additional storage. Located just 1.5 blocks from Taraval Streets MUNI lines, shops, and dining, this home offers a perfect mix of serene ocean views and urban convenience.
